utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hana, I’m glad the repair drive is coming together, but I’m still worried we don’t have a firm drop-off time. Could we ask Leo to confirm one before folks start hauling appliances to the shed?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, let’s check with Leo before anyone brings appliances over; I’ll ask him to confirm the drop-off time and whether the shed will be open.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thank you, Hana—that would ease my mind. Once Leo confirms the time and shed access, I can help pass the word so people don’t all arrive at once.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, I’m set to bring screwdrivers, pliers, a socket set, plus an extension cord and work light Saturday morning—anything else you want me to toss in for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: That’s perfect, Gus. If you’ve got labels or masking tape, toss those in too for marking parts and owners.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: You got it, Leo—I’ll bring masking tape and a marker along with the tools, cord, and work light Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Vik, I’m still waiting on a firm drop-off window for the repair drive—so please tell folks not to haul anything over just yet.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Got it, Tess — I’ll tell everyone to hold off on bringing items until Cleo or you confirm the drop-off window. I’ll make sure not to spread any guesses.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Vik, that’s perfect—once Cleo or I have the window pinned down, I’ll pass it along right away.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Uli, I’m still pinning down the start time with Rosa and Vik, but the urgent list so far is porch steps, leaky gutters, tools, patch materials, and batteries—do you know of anything else on your end?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I don’t know of anything else, Cleo. I’ll wait for the confirmed time and place, and I can quietly remind folks not to bring things over early.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Uli—that helps a lot. I’ll pass along that we shouldn’t have supplies arriving early, and I’ll circle back once Rosa and Vik confirm the time and place.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, I’m checking in with each group so Opal can see where the gaps are—do you know what your crew could cover for the repair drive, or what tools you might bring?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Quick version: I’m on Friday sign-in from 3:15 to 4, and Saturday I can only help later in the day. Tool-wise, don’t count on much from me unless someone gives me a specific ask.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Bo—that helps; I’ll mark you for Friday sign-in 3:15 to 4 and Saturday late-day only, with tools as specific-request only.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Rey, I’m still piecing the repair drive together from what folks have told me—have you heard who’s handling the drop-off list or what supplies are still needed?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Nell—Rosa’s organizing the drive, and Eli said he’s making the drop-off list this afternoon, sorted by tool type. I’d check with Rosa for the exact supplies still needed so I don’t pass along anything half-wrong.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Rey—that helps a lot. I’ll check with Rosa about the supply gaps and follow up with Eli once his drop-off list is ready.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Eli, the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and I’m helping track tools, drop-offs, and who’s available—are you thinking of bringing anything or volunteering for a short shift?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Sam—I’m coordinating the list and can take a short Sunday morning shift. I’ll bring the sign-up categories and let Gus know we especially need screwdrivers, pliers, and a socket set.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Eli—that’s perfect. I’ll mark you for Sunday morning and add screwdrivers, pliers, and a socket set to the priority tool list for Gus.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Faye, I’m still catching up, but the repair drive is Sunday at the community center now. I can help with setup, and I’m checking who’s got tools and who can cover sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Dane — I had only confirmed Friday sign-in before, so I’ll update my notes that it’s Sunday at the community center. I can help coordinate around pickup timing, and I’ll check who’s better for tools versus sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Faye — pickup timing would help a lot, since I’m still short on firm tool counts and sign-up coverage. If you hear who can cover which, send it my way and I’ll fold it into the setup plan.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks again, Opal — I’m just waiting on Mara’s final drop-off spot and windows, and I’ll send them your way the moment I have them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn—once you have Mara’s confirmed spot and windows, I’ll map the stations and send invitations with the right drop-off details so nothing overlaps.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That sounds perfect, Opal — I’ll nudge Mara for the final spot and windows, then get them to you right away so your station map and invites line up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hi Noah, I’m still trying to pin down confirmed names before we say six volunteers, and Mina’s chasing the exact bike, lamp, and appliance counts.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Ira — I’ll hold off on telling folks six volunteers until you’ve got the names, and I’ll keep saying Saturday morning at the community shed with final counts still pending.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Noah—please also avoid locking in the shed spot just yet, since Eli mentioned setting drop-off by the library table, and I’m waiting for that to firm up.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Mina, I’m glad we’re checking in—Faye is penciled in for 2:30 to 3:15, Gus can bring tools once the drop-off windows are set, and I’m finishing the sign-up sheet with station and tools columns today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, Mara—who’s confirming the drop-off window, and when will the sign-up sheet be somewhere people can actually use it?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll confirm the drop-off window with Opal this afternoon, and I’ll have the sign-up sheet ready to share by tonight so folks can start claiming stations.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oren, can you confirm if you’re able to help with the repair drive, and if so whether Saturday morning works or only later in the day?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Kira, yes—I do mean to help with the repair drive. Saturday morning should work for me, though if Vik gave an exact start time I’ve gone and misplaced it in my head again.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Oren—can you confirm you’re good for Saturday morning once we have the exact start time, and I’ll check whether Vik has posted it yet?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Rosa, I’m still waiting on the firm drop-off window, but Mara says Faye’s penciled in for 2:30 to 3:15 and Gus can help with tools once we’ve got the timing settled.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess—that’s really helpful. Let’s hold Faye for 2:30 to 3:15 on Sunday at the community center, and once you confirm the drop-off window I’ll plug Gus into the tool setup.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Rosa—I’ll keep Faye penciled in for Sunday and won’t send folks hauling things over until I’ve got that drop-off window firm.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, do you know the firm volunteer count and what repairs Eli wants us prioritizing for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Mina, I wish I had the firm count, but I don’t—Cleo may have that. I think Eli wanted porch steps and leaky gutters first, though I’d better not swear to it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Alright, I’ll ask Cleo for the count and confirm priorities with Eli; can you tell me exactly who mentioned porch steps and gutters so I’m not chasing rumors?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Gus, I’ve only got “Saturday morning at the community shed” confirmed so far, and I’m waiting on Leo for the actual start time before I tell anyone to haul appliances over.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Pia — I’ll hold off on sending folks over until Leo confirms the time. I’m still planning to bring screwdrivers, pliers, the socket set, plus an extension cord and work light Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds useful, Gus—just keep the cord and work light handy but don’t load up too early until Leo gives us the start time and any setup instructions.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Ira, I’m still confirming the start time, but Rosa and I are lining up supplies for porch steps, leaky gutters, tools, patch materials, and batteries—do you know any urgent repairs on your end?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I don’t have anything firm beyond Mina still needing the volunteer count and exact bike, lamp, and appliance numbers. I’ll keep listening while I’m out, and once you confirm the time, drop-off spot, and supply list, I’ll help pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Ira—that helps. I’ll keep chasing the time, drop-off spot, and counts, and I’ll send you the confirmed details as soon as Rosa and I have them.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mara, I’m helping Opal line up groups for the repair drive—do you know if your folks can cover drop-off help, tools, or taking names of busted items?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes—Faye is penciled in from 2:30 to 3:15, Gus can bring screwdrivers, pliers, and a socket set once the list is ready, and Leo is already set for Saturday morning intake at the community shed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s perfect, Mara—I'll mark Leo for Saturday morning intake, Faye for 2:30 to 3:15, and Gus for tools once Opal’s list is ready. I’ll connect this with Sam’s crew so we don’t double up on the same gear.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Noah, I’m helping coordinate the repair drive now that it’s moved to Sunday at the community center—are you able to bring any tools or volunteer for a shift?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh wow, I had the old Saturday-at-the-shed info, thanks for catching me up. I can do a Sunday morning shift at the community center and bring a basic toolkit plus an extension cord.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’s perfect, thanks Noah—I’ll put you down for Sunday morning with a basic toolkit and extension cord. If Rosa or Opal needs a specific station covered, I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Opal, sorry I’m sliding in late as usual—I’m still confirming the volunteer count and exact bike, lamp, and appliance numbers, but I can send Jules our collection table coverage and tool list as soon as I’ve got it firm.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane—please send Jules the collection table coverage and tool list once confirmed, and copy me so I can keep the station map and item counts from overlapping.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Will do—I’ll copy you when I send Jules the confirmed coverage, tool list, and item counts so your map stays clean.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Rey, I’m glad to help with the repair drive, but I’m still waiting on the confirmed Saturday start time and whether tools or sign-up help is needed most.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Hana — I’m still waiting on the confirmed start time too, but Rosa’s coordinating it, and Eli mentioned keeping tool drop-offs organized by type. I can check back with them and pass along whether tools or sign-up help is needed most.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey—that would help. I’ll hold off on choosing a Saturday role until you hear from Rosa or Eli about the start time and whether tools or sign-up needs more hands.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Faye, just confirming I’m still good for the Friday sign-in table from 3:15 to 4—do you know who’s holding the main drop-off list?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Bo—yes, I still have you down for Friday 3:15 to 4. I’m checking with Mara on who has the main drop-off list, so I’ll point you to them before pickup gets hectic.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks—just send me the name when you’ve got it, and I’ll show up Friday at 3:15 for the sign-in table.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Quinn, before we spread anything, can you confirm whether Mara has actually set the drop-off windows yet, or are we still only sharing item types for now?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You’re right to check, Kira—we’re still waiting on Mara to confirm the drop-off windows and spot, so for now I’m only telling folks what kinds of items to gather.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good, thanks for confirming—let’s hold off on sharing any times or location until Mara gives the final word, and stick to item types for now.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Uli, I’m still piecing together the repair drive from everyone’s updates—have you heard whether they still need cords, a work light, or help tying the lists together?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Nell—Quinn only told me they need broken household items, help sorting parts, or help spreading the word, and that the time and place aren’t firm yet. I can help quietly with updates once Quinn passes along the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Uli—that’s helpful. I’ll note that items, parts-sorting, and word-spreading are the current needs, and I’ll wait for Quinn’s firmer time and place before passing anything along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hey Leo, I’m waiting on Cleo to confirm the repair drive’s exact start time and supplies, then I’ll pass the details around so nobody gets mixed up.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Vik. I’ll hold off on sharing anything new until Cleo confirms, but I’m still set for the shed intake table Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Perfect, thanks Leo—I’ll note you for the shed intake table Saturday morning, and I’ll circle back once Cleo confirms the exact time and supply list.
